narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 5 awards so far this fiscal year and the average award size is $451M. Historical obligations include FY21 $78.4M and FY26 $2.3B. The Department of Homeland Security accounts for $2.2B of obligations, while the Department of Defense accounts for $10.6M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market with $2.2B in obligations. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M. The page notes that figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and that current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This summary highlights the agency concentration, market mix, award count, and award-size profile to give a clear snapshot of Southwest Valley Constructors' federal activity in FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Southwest Valley Constructors' FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security accounts for $2.2B of Southwest Valley Constructors' $2.3B in FY2026 obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors received 5 awards in FY2026 to date and the average award size is $451M. The Department of Defense provided $10.6M in obligations, showing a concentration with one agency.

sections.heading: What markets drive Southwest Valley Constructors' federal revenue?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.2B of Southwest Valley Constructors' FY2026 obligations. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M. The FY2026 totals dominate the reported series compared with FY21 $78.4M.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors received 5 awards so far this fiscal year and the average award size is $451M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys most from Southwest Valley Constructors, with $2.2B in obligations. The Department of Defense also buys from Southwest Valley Constructors, with $10.6M in obligations.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells construction services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market with $2.2B in obligations, and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M.
